summary: Verified bug fix for admin 'Save new password' flow end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest passing (request-otp, seeded verify-otp, set-password happy path, questions with admin token, password login, invalid setup token→401 with correct detail, short password→422). Frontend (mobile 390x844 via preview URL): OTP send + seeded verify reached password stage; the Save new password button is NOT disabled with short input and now surfaces inline errors ('Enter and confirm your new password' + 12-character minimum); mismatch shows 'Passwords do not match'; live counter (admin-password-counter) and match indicator (admin-password-match) render as expected; valid password transitions to Admin studio ('Keep the blitz fresh.'); logout + password login via admin-use-password/admin-sign-in returns to Admin studio. Bug is FIXED. Also updated /app/memory/test_credentials.md to reflect the current active password NewOwnerPass2026!.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses in-memory admin_sessions dict — tokens (both setup and admin) are lost on any backend restart, which is called out in the agent-to-agent note but is worth persisting for a real deploy.
admin_login returns 401 for both 'wrong email' and 'wrong password' but 403 when password has never been set — 403 leaks that the email is the valid admin. Consider unifying to a generic 401 message.
Admin.tsx is a single ~100-line-of-JSX file mixing several screens/panels. It works but is nearing the readability limit; splitting the panels would help future maintenance (not a blocker).
seed_data_creation: For OTP verification tests, seeded /test_database/admin_otps with digest=hmac_sha256(OTP_PEPPER,'999888') via /tmp/seed_otp.py. The admin_accounts document now has password_hash for 'NewOwnerPass2026!'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin password is now 'NewOwnerPass2026!'. To re-run the OTP path, seed a fresh doc into admin_otps (cooldown is 60s on request-otp). Setup tokens are single-use and invalidated on backend restart. Frontend flow depends on testIDs admin-send-otp, admin-otp, admin-verify-otp, admin-new-password, admin-confirm-password, admin-set-password, admin-password-counter, admin-password-match, admin-logout, admin-use-password, admin-password, admin-sign-in — all present and working.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: PrimaryButton for admin-set-password was rendered with disabled={newPassword.length<12} which prevented onPress from firing and gave no visible feedback. Fix (already applied by main agent): removed the disabled prop and moved all validation into finishPassword() which now sets an inline error for empty fields, <12 chars, and mismatch; also added live counter/match helper Text nodes and a recovery branch when the setup_token has expired (returns user to OTP stage with an explanatory error). Verified by tapping the button in three scenarios (short pw, mismatch, valid) — the button now fires and either shows the correct error message or transitions to Admin studio.
